notes.title: The final Pre-Demo build
notes.content:
[h3]Fixed:[/h3]
Dialog logic
The error that caused the game to crash on the second day
Errors in dialogs
The mouse sharpness is saved in the pause menu
The settings from the pause menu are saved

[h3]Added:[/h3]
Voice acting, the ability to turn it off and on.

notes.title: PATCH NOTE 2
notes.content:
[h3]Fix:[/h3]
Error when passing the maze to the middle ending returned to the first day
Error where settings were not saved correctly

[h3]Added:[/h3]
When you complete the DEMO, you can click Continue and skip Nikolai's first dream.
